message:

hold_reason: Refund mismatch on order 211: Alpha reports 24506 cents applied, but the signed batch requested 12701 cents (over-applied by 11805 cents). Orders 213 (15133) and 214 (6668) match. Refunds are not verified as complete and correct, so no payouts were recorded. Needs human review of the order 211 refund before payouts run.

reply.thought: Alpha's handoff reports order 211 refunded for 24506 cents, but the signed batch requested only 12701 cents. The other two refunds match. The refund work is not correct, so paying out could send customers the wrong amounts. A recorded payout cannot be recalled, so I'm holding the batch for review.
